column1: # MODULES.tsv — generated summary of the out-of-tree kernel modules in this repository.
# Regenerated 2026-09-15 from the directories here, the shipped module set's build manifest,
# and the device tree's modules.load* files. Do not hand-edit: regenerate instead.
# module = kernel module name (matches modules.load) | file = .ko filename |
# stage(s) = which boot stage ships it (1-ramdisk = first-stage init, 2-dlkm = vendor_dlkm, recovery) |
# build_dir = subdirectory here holding the module's Makefile (M= for kbuild).
